context: Hindi/Hinglish customer utterances in Indian loan, EMI, and payment collection calls. Classify only the current utterance; do not infer missing conversation context.

intents.name: AFFIRMATIVE_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT
intents.definition: Generic positive acknowledgement or acceptance with no more specific meaning.
intents.notes: Do not infer what is accepted. Specific meaning overrides this label.

intents.name: NEGATIVE_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT
intents.definition: Generic negative acknowledgement or denial with no more specific meaning.

intents.name: CONTINUE_CONVERSATION
intents.definition: Customer clearly asks, permits, or prompts the agent to continue speaking or explaining.
intents.notes: A bare acknowledgement is not this intent.

intents.name: IDENTITY_CONFIRMED
intents.definition: Customer explicitly confirms they are the intended person.
intents.notes: हाँ alone is not identity confirmation.

intents.name: THIRD_PARTY_AVAILABLE
intents.definition: Customer says the intended person is available, coming to the phone, or is being handed the phone.

intents.name: THIRD_PARTY_UNAVAILABLE
intents.definition: Customer says the intended person is unavailable or cannot talk now.
intents.notes: An explicit request to call later is CALL_DEFER.

intents.name: PAY_NOW_AGREE
intents.definition: Clear commitment to make payment immediately or now.
intents.notes: Requires payment action and immediate timing.

intents.name: PAY_LATER_AGREE
intents.definition: Clear commitment to make payment later with future timing.
intents.notes: Maybe, try, or देखता हूँ are UNCLEAR_INPUT.

intents.name: PAID_ALREADY
intents.definition: Customer clearly says payment has already been completed.

intents.name: REFUSE_TO_PAY
intents.definition: Clear refusal or unwillingness to pay without giving a reason.
intents.notes: If a reason for inability or delay is given, use NO_PAYMENT_REASON.

intents.name: NO_PAYMENT_REASON
intents.definition: Clear reason for not paying or payment delay.

intents.name: END_CALL
intents.definition: Customer explicitly ends the current call.

intents.name: DO_NOT_CALL
intents.definition: Customer asks not to be called or contacted again.
examples: इस नंबर पर कॉल मत करना

intents.name: CALL_DEFER
intents.definition: Customer explicitly asks the caller to call or contact later.
examples: अभी busy हूँ बाद में कॉल करिए

intents.name: WRONG_NUMBER
intents.definition: Customer clearly says the number or person is wrong, or that the intended person does not live here.

intents.name: BACKCHANNEL_OR_NOISE
intents.definition: Clearly non-semantic sound, noise, cough, breathing, or meaningless vocalization.
intents.notes: Meaningful हाँ or जी is normally AFFIRMATIVE_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT, not noise.

intents.name: UNCLEAR_INPUT
intents.definition: Safe fallback for ambiguous, incomplete, context-dependent, unreliable, or out-of-taxonomy utterances.
intents.notes: Use whenever meaningful doubt remains; false positives are worse.
